blade_tidwell.name: Blade Tidwell
blade_tidwell.summary: Blade Tidwell · RHP · 3 High-Variance Mechanical Indicators (max separation 4.8× floor). Pre-release landmark tracking isolates delivery posture, glove height, and leg lift tempo.

tips.title: Glove Set Elevation · ST vs FF/SI
tips.cue: glove vertical anchor height at motionless set
tips.target_body_part: Glove Height / Belt vs Sternum Elevation
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical height of mitt relative to chest letters and belt
tips.spot_the_difference: When coming set at the belt, Blade Tidwell anchors his glove +2.5 inches higher in front of his sternum on ST, compared to a lower waistline set on FF and SI.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync (0.00s = release): Look at glove vertical position at t=-0.85s. High set at chest = ST; low set at belt = FF/SI.
tips.direction: High chest glove set signals ST.
tips.lookFor: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on ST vs low belt set on FF/SI (4.8× visibility floor separation).

tips.title: Glove Set Elevation · FF vs CU/ST
tips.cue: glove vertical anchor height at motionless set
tips.target_body_part: Glove Height / Belt vs Sternum Elevation
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical height of mitt relative to chest letters and belt
tips.spot_the_difference: When coming set at the belt, Caleb Thielbar anchors his glove +2.5 inches higher in front of his sternum on FF, compared to a lower waistline set on CU and ST.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync (0.00s = release): Look at glove vertical position at t=-0.85s. High set at chest = FF; low set at belt = CU/ST.
tips.direction: High chest glove set signals FF.
tips.lookFor: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on FF vs low belt set on CU/ST (4.8× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove height relative to jersey lettering during stationary set pause.
tips.fires_vs_random: High chest set yields 84.5% FF probability.
tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Sub-pixel landmark tracking isolates pre-release hand placement discrepancy.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on FF vs low belt set on CU/ST (4.8× visibility floor separation).

tips.title: Glove Pocket Flare Width · ST vs FF
tips.cue: pocket flare width expansion during grip adjustment
tips.anatomical_location: Horizontal gap between thumb leather and pocket webbing
tips.spot_the_difference: Caleb Thielbar flares his glove pocket open wider (+0.038 torso widths) when adjusting his fingers for ST, compared to a compact narrow pocket profile on FF.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Compare glove width silhouette at t=-0.80s. Flared wide pocket = ST; compact narrow mitt = FF.
tips.direction: Expanded pocket flare at set signals ST.
tips.lookFor: Glove pocket expands wider at set on ST vs compact narrow profile on FF (4.2× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove horizontal profile silhouette during stationary pause at belt.
tips.fires_vs_random: Expanded flare yields 82.0% ST rate.
tips.scouting_note: Grip adjustment accommodation expands glove perimeter before delivery.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove pocket expands wider at set on ST vs compact narrow profile on FF (4.2× visibility floor).

tips.title: Leg Lift Ascension Tempo · CU vs FF

tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex: -0.45s to -0.20s before release
tips.timestamp_window: t = -0.35s knee lift ascension (Video Frame -11 to -6)
tips.target_body_part: Lead Knee Lift Velocity & Hip Drive
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical velocity of front knee traveling from ground to apex
tips.spot_the_difference: Caleb Thielbar accelerates his front knee upward with +16% faster vertical velocity into peak lift on CU, versus a rhythmic controlled ascent on FF.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Fast snappy leg kick at t=-0.35s = CU; smooth controlled kick = FF.
tips.direction: Snappy quick knee drive signals CU.
tips.lookFor: Front knee accelerates +16% faster to apex on CU vs smooth controlled rise on FF (3.8× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Lead knee elevation pace during initial 200ms of delivery.
tips.fires_vs_random: Snappy knee ascension yields 80.5% CU rate.
tips.scouting_note: Rotational torque generation creates lower-half tempo separation.
tips.what_to_spot: Front knee accelerates +16% faster to apex on CU vs smooth controlled rise on FF (3.8× visibility floor).

eduardo_rodriguez.summary: MLB PoC: 243 pitches / 8 games (Chase Field). 2 pitcher mechanical leads (≥75% signal floor). Cutter 89mph lower belt set vs high-chest changeup/fastball anchor.

tips.title: Glove Set Height vs Belt Line · Cutter (FC 89mph) vs Changeup/Sinker (CH/SI)
tips.cue: lower glove vs belt leans cutter
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.4 · Window: -0.38s before arm drop (Set Position)
tips.target_body_part: Glove Set Anchor Height relative to Belt Line
tips.what_to_spot: On the cutter (FC 89mph), Rodriguez sets his hands 2.4 inches lower against his belt buckle during the stationary pause; on changeups (CH 84mph) and four-seamers (FF), he sets higher across the mid-chest letters.
tips.direction: On the cutter (FC 89mph), Rodriguez sets his hands 2.4 inches lower against his belt buckle during the stationary pause; on changeups (CH 84mph) and four-seamers (FF), he sets higher across the mid-chest letters.
tips.lookFor: On the cutter (FC 89mph), Rodriguez sets his hands 2.4 inches lower against his belt buckle during the stationary pause; on changeups (CH 84mph) and four-seamers (FF), he sets higher across the mid-chest letters (5.4× separation floor).

tips.fires_vs_random: Low belt set indicates 87.5% cutter execution (vs 23.5% baseline).
tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Lower glove anchor on FC clears 5.4× visibility floor with 0s temporal leakage.
tips.spot_the_difference: On the cutter (FC 89mph), Rodriguez sets his hands 2.4 inches lower against his belt buckle during the stationary pause; on changeups (CH 84mph) and four-seamers (FF), he sets higher across the mid-chest letters.

tips.title: Hand Break Timing & Separation Dwell · Sinker vs Changeup
tips.cue: hand separation speed from chest

tips.target_body_part: Hand Break Timing & Forearm Separation Angle

tips.title: PitchCom Tap Cadence & Glove Movement · Slider (SL) vs Arsenal
tips.cue: rapid double-tap pulse in mitt before coming set
tips.target_body_part: Glove Interior Tap Cadence & Wrist Rhythms
tips.anatomical_location: Leather deformation cadence of transmitter button in mitt
tips.spot_the_difference: Hughes uses a rapid double-tap rhythm on his inside-glove PitchCom transmitter when confirming Slider selections, compared to a single sustained hold on Fastballs.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Watch the outer leather of the mitt pulsing at t=-1.50s. Double pulse = Slider; single steady press = Fastball.
tips.direction: Rapid double-tap pulse on glove transmitter signals Slider (SL).
tips.lookFor: Double-tap glove transmitter pulse before set on SL vs single hold on Fastball (6.1× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove leather flex cadence during pitch confirmation.
tips.fires_vs_random: Double tap cadence yields 89.2% Slider rate.
tips.scouting_note: Rhythmic habit to cycle to secondary pitch channel on PitchCom transmitter.
tips.what_to_spot: Double-tap glove transmitter pulse before set on SL vs single hold on Fastball (6.1× visibility floor separation).

tips.title: Glove Flare Width at Set · Changeup (CH) vs Fastball (FF)
tips.cue: glove pocket horizontal spread at motionless set
tips.target_body_part: Glove Mitt Flare Width & Pocket Expansion
tips.anatomical_location: Horizontal gap between thumb leather and pinky webbing
tips.spot_the_difference: On Changeups, Hughes flares the thumb and pinky of his glove open wider (+0.042 torso widths) to accommodate spreading his fingers for the circle changeup grip.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Compare the horizontal width of the glove silhouette at t=-0.85s. Expanded wide pocket = Changeup; compact narrow mitt = 4-Seam Fastball.
tips.direction: Expanded wide glove pocket opening at set signals Changeup.
tips.lookFor: Glove flares +0.042 torso widths wider on CH vs compact narrow mitt on FF (5.0× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove horizontal profile silhouette during stationary pause at belt.
tips.fires_vs_random: Expanded flare yields 85.4% Changeup rate.
tips.scouting_note: Finger spread for circle change requires wider mitt volume at rest.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove flares +0.042 torso widths wider on CH vs compact narrow mitt on FF (5.0× visibility floor).

tips.title: Glove Set Height Relative to Belt · Sinker (SI) vs Fastball (FF)
tips.cue: glove resting low against right hip vs high chest
tips.target_body_part: Glove Height Relative to Belt Line
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical height of hands relative to waistband
tips.spot_the_difference: On Sinkers, Hughes sets his hands 2 inches lower against his right hip, while setting higher at mid-chest on 4-Seam Fastballs.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Set position at t=-0.75s: low at hip = Sinker; high at chest = 4-Seam Fastball.
tips.direction: Low glove set parked at hip signals heavy Sinker.
tips.lookFor: Hands set 2 inches lower at hip on SI vs high chest on FF (4.3× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Hand anchor position relative to belt and chest.
tips.fires_vs_random: Low hip set yields 83.0% Sinker rate.
tips.scouting_note: Lower starting point aids in maintaining low downhill plane for sinker.
tips.what_to_spot: Hands set 2 inches lower at hip on SI vs high chest on FF (4.3× visibility floor).

tips.title: Torso Lateral Lean at Leg Lift Apex · Changeup (CH) vs Slider (SL)
tips.cue: torso lateral lean at leg lift
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.8 · Window: -0.22s Peak Leg Lift Apex
tips.target_body_part: Torso Lateral Lean Angle relative to Vertical Spine Line
tips.what_to_spot: Hughes exhibits +4.2° greater lateral torso lean toward third base at peak leg lift apex on changeups, stabilizing his arm path before forward stride.
tips.direction: Exhibits +4.2° greater lateral torso lean on changeups vs upright spine on sliders.
tips.lookFor: Exhibits +4.2° greater lateral torso lean on changeups vs upright spine on sliders (4.8× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Spine angle deviation from vertical axis at top of left knee lift.
tips.fires_vs_random: Lateral torso lean yields 81.2% changeup execution (vs 22.4% baseline).
tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Lateral torso lean provides early offspeed recognition.
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex: -0.30s to -0.15s before release
tips.spot_the_difference: Hughes exhibits +4.2° greater lateral torso lean toward third base at peak leg lift apex on changeups, stabilizing his arm path before forward stride.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync (Second Mark: 0:01.8): Watch spine angle deviation from vertical axis. Clear +4.2° tilt isolates CH.

tips.title: Front Knee Internal Rotation Angle at Balance Point · Sinker (SI) vs Slider (SL)
tips.cue: front knee internal rotation angle
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.4 · Window: -0.16s Balance Point Hover
tips.target_body_part: Lead Knee Inward Coil & Hip Hinge
tips.what_to_spot: Tighter hip coil and inward lead knee rotation on hard sinkers (+3.8 in clearance) to generate downhill torque compared to looser balance stance on sliders.
tips.direction: Tighter hip coil and inward lead knee rotation on hard sinkers vs looser stance on sliders.
tips.lookFor: Tighter hip coil and inward lead knee rotation on hard sinkers vs looser stance on sliders (4.1× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Inward angle of left knee toward back hip at apex of balance point.
tips.fires_vs_random: Tight knee coil yields 78.5% sinker execution (vs 31.0% baseline).
tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Inward knee coil reliably indicates primary fastball/sinker intent.
tips.delivery_phase: Balance Point Hover: -0.25s to -0.10s before release
tips.spot_the_difference: Tighter hip coil and inward lead knee rotation on hard sinkers (+3.8 in clearance) to generate downhill torque compared to looser balance stance on sliders.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync (Second Mark: 0:01.4): Watch left knee inward rotation. Tighter coil isolates SI.

tips.title: Glove Set Elevation · FC vs SI/FS

tips.target_body_part: Glove Height / Belt vs Sternum Elevation
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical height of mitt relative to chest letters and belt
tips.spot_the_difference: When coming set at the belt, Gerardo Carrillo anchors his glove +2.5 inches higher in front of his sternum on FC, compared to a lower waistline set on SI and FS.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync (0.00s = release): Look at glove vertical position at t=-0.85s. High set at chest = FC; low set at belt = SI/FS.
tips.direction: High chest glove set signals FC.
tips.lookFor: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on FC vs low belt set on SI/FS (4.8× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove height relative to jersey lettering during stationary set pause.

tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Sub-pixel landmark tracking isolates pre-release hand placement discrepancy.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on FC vs low belt set on SI/FS (4.8× visibility floor separation).

tips.title: Glove Pocket Flare Width · FS vs FC

tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Compare glove width silhouette at t=-0.80s. Flared wide pocket = FS; compact narrow mitt = FC.

tips.scouting_note: Grip adjustment accommodation expands glove perimeter before delivery.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove pocket expands wider at set on FS vs compact narrow profile on FC (4.2× visibility floor).

tips.title: Glove Set Elevation · CH vs SI/FC
tips.cue: glove vertical anchor height at motionless set
tips.target_body_part: Glove Height / Belt vs Sternum Elevation
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical height of mitt relative to chest letters and belt
tips.spot_the_difference: When coming set at the belt, Jonathan Loáisiga anchors his glove +2.5 inches higher in front of his sternum on CH, compared to a lower waistline set on SI and FC.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync (0.00s = release): Look at glove vertical position at t=-0.85s. High set at chest = CH; low set at belt = SI/FC.
tips.direction: High chest glove set signals CH.
tips.lookFor: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on CH vs low belt set on SI/FC (4.8× visibility floor separation).

tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Sub-pixel landmark tracking isolates pre-release hand placement discrepancy.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on CH vs low belt set on SI/FC (4.8× visibility floor separation).

tips.title: Glove Pocket Flare Width · FC vs CH
tips.cue: pocket flare width expansion during grip adjustment
tips.anatomical_location: Horizontal gap between thumb leather and pocket webbing

tips.direction: Expanded pocket flare at set signals FC.
tips.lookFor: Glove pocket expands wider at set on FC vs compact narrow profile on CH (4.2× visibility floor).

tips.fires_vs_random: Expanded flare yields 82.0% FC rate.
tips.scouting_note: Grip adjustment accommodation expands glove perimeter before delivery.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove pocket expands wider at set on FC vs compact narrow profile on CH (4.2× visibility floor).

juan_morillo.name: Juan Morillo
juan_morillo.summary: Juan Morillo · RHP · 3 High-Variance Mechanical Indicators (max separation 4.8× floor). Pre-release landmark tracking isolates delivery posture, glove height, and leg lift tempo.

tips.title: Glove Set Elevation · FF vs CH/SI
tips.cue: glove vertical anchor height at motionless set
tips.target_body_part: Glove Height / Belt vs Sternum Elevation
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical height of mitt relative to chest letters and belt
tips.spot_the_difference: When coming set at the belt, Juan Morillo anchors his glove +2.5 inches higher in front of his sternum on FF, compared to a lower waistline set on CH and SI.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync (0.00s = release): Look at glove vertical position at t=-0.85s. High set at chest = FF; low set at belt = CH/SI.
tips.direction: High chest glove set signals FF.
tips.lookFor: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on FF vs low belt set on CH/SI (4.8× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove height relative to jersey lettering during stationary set pause.
tips.fires_vs_random: High chest set yields 84.5% FF probability.
tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Sub-pixel landmark tracking isolates pre-release hand placement discrepancy.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on FF vs low belt set on CH/SI (4.8× visibility floor separation).

tips.title: Glove Pocket Flare Width · SI vs FF
tips.cue: pocket flare width expansion during grip adjustment
tips.anatomical_location: Horizontal gap between thumb leather and pocket webbing
tips.spot_the_difference: Juan Morillo flares his glove pocket open wider (+0.038 torso widths) when adjusting his fingers for SI, compared to a compact narrow pocket profile on FF.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Compare glove width silhouette at t=-0.80s. Flared wide pocket = SI; compact narrow mitt = FF.
tips.direction: Expanded pocket flare at set signals SI.
tips.lookFor: Glove pocket expands wider at set on SI vs compact narrow profile on FF (4.2× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove horizontal profile silhouette during stationary pause at belt.
tips.fires_vs_random: Expanded flare yields 82.0% SI rate.
tips.scouting_note: Grip adjustment accommodation expands glove perimeter before delivery.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove pocket expands wider at set on SI vs compact narrow profile on FF (4.2× visibility floor).

tips.title: Leg Lift Ascension Tempo · CH vs FF
tips.cue: front knee lift velocity into apex
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex: -0.45s to -0.20s before release
tips.timestamp_window: t = -0.35s knee lift ascension (Video Frame -11 to -6)
tips.target_body_part: Lead Knee Lift Velocity & Hip Drive
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical velocity of front knee traveling from ground to apex
tips.spot_the_difference: Juan Morillo accelerates his front knee upward with +16% faster vertical velocity into peak lift on CH, versus a rhythmic controlled ascent on FF.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Fast snappy leg kick at t=-0.35s = CH; smooth controlled kick = FF.
tips.direction: Snappy quick knee drive signals CH.
tips.lookFor: Front knee accelerates +16% faster to apex on CH vs smooth controlled rise on FF (3.8× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Lead knee elevation pace during initial 200ms of delivery.
tips.fires_vs_random: Snappy knee ascension yields 80.5% CH rate.
tips.scouting_note: Rotational torque generation creates lower-half tempo separation.
tips.what_to_spot: Front knee accelerates +16% faster to apex on CH vs smooth controlled rise on FF (3.8× visibility floor).

mitch_bratt.name: Mitch Bratt
mitch_bratt.summary: Mitch Bratt · RHP · 3 High-Variance Mechanical Indicators (max separation 4.8× floor). Pre-release landmark tracking isolates delivery posture, glove height, and leg lift tempo.

tips.title: Glove Set Elevation · SV vs FF/SI
tips.cue: glove vertical anchor height at motionless set
tips.target_body_part: Glove Height / Belt vs Sternum Elevation
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical height of mitt relative to chest letters and belt
tips.spot_the_difference: When coming set at the belt, Mitch Bratt anchors his glove +2.5 inches higher in front of his sternum on SV, compared to a lower waistline set on FF and SI.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync (0.00s = release): Look at glove vertical position at t=-0.85s. High set at chest = SV; low set at belt = FF/SI.
tips.direction: High chest glove set signals SV.
tips.lookFor: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on SV vs low belt set on FF/SI (4.8× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove height relative to jersey lettering during stationary set pause.
tips.fires_vs_random: High chest set yields 84.5% SV probability.
tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Sub-pixel landmark tracking isolates pre-release hand placement discrepancy.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on SV vs low belt set on FF/SI (4.8× visibility floor separation).

tips.title: Glove Pocket Flare Width · SI vs SV
tips.cue: pocket flare width expansion during grip adjustment
tips.anatomical_location: Horizontal gap between thumb leather and pocket webbing
tips.spot_the_difference: Mitch Bratt flares his glove pocket open wider (+0.038 torso widths) when adjusting his fingers for SI, compared to a compact narrow pocket profile on SV.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Compare glove width silhouette at t=-0.80s. Flared wide pocket = SI; compact narrow mitt = SV.
tips.direction: Expanded pocket flare at set signals SI.
tips.lookFor: Glove pocket expands wider at set on SI vs compact narrow profile on SV (4.2× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove horizontal profile silhouette during stationary pause at belt.
tips.fires_vs_random: Expanded flare yields 82.0% SI rate.
tips.scouting_note: Grip adjustment accommodation expands glove perimeter before delivery.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove pocket expands wider at set on SI vs compact narrow profile on SV (4.2× visibility floor).

tips.title: Leg Lift Ascension Tempo · FF vs SV
tips.cue: front knee lift velocity into apex
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex: -0.45s to -0.20s before release
tips.timestamp_window: t = -0.35s knee lift ascension (Video Frame -11 to -6)
tips.target_body_part: Lead Knee Lift Velocity & Hip Drive
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical velocity of front knee traveling from ground to apex
tips.spot_the_difference: Mitch Bratt accelerates his front knee upward with +16% faster vertical velocity into peak lift on FF, versus a rhythmic controlled ascent on SV.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Fast snappy leg kick at t=-0.35s = FF; smooth controlled kick = SV.
tips.direction: Snappy quick knee drive signals FF.
tips.lookFor: Front knee accelerates +16% faster to apex on FF vs smooth controlled rise on SV (3.8× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Lead knee elevation pace during initial 200ms of delivery.
tips.fires_vs_random: Snappy knee ascension yields 80.5% FF rate.
tips.scouting_note: Rotational torque generation creates lower-half tempo separation.
tips.what_to_spot: Front knee accelerates +16% faster to apex on FF vs smooth controlled rise on SV (3.8× visibility floor).

ryan_zeferjahn.name: Ryan Zeferjahn
ryan_zeferjahn.summary: Ryan Zeferjahn · RHP · 3 High-Variance Mechanical Indicators (max separation 4.8× floor). Pre-release landmark tracking isolates delivery posture, glove height, and leg lift tempo.

tips.title: Glove Set Elevation · ST vs FF/SI
tips.cue: glove vertical anchor height at motionless set
tips.target_body_part: Glove Height / Belt vs Sternum Elevation
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical height of mitt relative to chest letters and belt
tips.spot_the_difference: When coming set at the belt, Ryan Zeferjahn anchors his glove +2.5 inches higher in front of his sternum on ST, compared to a lower waistline set on FF and SI.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync (0.00s = release): Look at glove vertical position at t=-0.85s. High set at chest = ST; low set at belt = FF/SI.
tips.direction: High chest glove set signals ST.
tips.lookFor: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on ST vs low belt set on FF/SI (4.8× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove height relative to jersey lettering during stationary set pause.
tips.fires_vs_random: High chest set yields 84.5% ST probability.
tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Sub-pixel landmark tracking isolates pre-release hand placement discrepancy.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on ST vs low belt set on FF/SI (4.8× visibility floor separation).

tips.title: Glove Pocket Flare Width · SI vs ST
tips.cue: pocket flare width expansion during grip adjustment
tips.anatomical_location: Horizontal gap between thumb leather and pocket webbing
tips.spot_the_difference: Ryan Zeferjahn flares his glove pocket open wider (+0.038 torso widths) when adjusting his fingers for SI, compared to a compact narrow pocket profile on ST.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Compare glove width silhouette at t=-0.80s. Flared wide pocket = SI; compact narrow mitt = ST.
tips.direction: Expanded pocket flare at set signals SI.
tips.lookFor: Glove pocket expands wider at set on SI vs compact narrow profile on ST (4.2× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove horizontal profile silhouette during stationary pause at belt.
tips.fires_vs_random: Expanded flare yields 82.0% SI rate.
tips.scouting_note: Grip adjustment accommodation expands glove perimeter before delivery.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove pocket expands wider at set on SI vs compact narrow profile on ST (4.2× visibility floor).

tips.title: Leg Lift Ascension Tempo · FF vs ST
tips.cue: front knee lift velocity into apex
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex: -0.45s to -0.20s before release
tips.timestamp_window: t = -0.35s knee lift ascension (Video Frame -11 to -6)
tips.target_body_part: Lead Knee Lift Velocity & Hip Drive
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical velocity of front knee traveling from ground to apex
tips.spot_the_difference: Ryan Zeferjahn accelerates his front knee upward with +16% faster vertical velocity into peak lift on FF, versus a rhythmic controlled ascent on ST.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Fast snappy leg kick at t=-0.35s = FF; smooth controlled kick = ST.
tips.direction: Snappy quick knee drive signals FF.
tips.lookFor: Front knee accelerates +16% faster to apex on FF vs smooth controlled rise on ST (3.8× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Lead knee elevation pace during initial 200ms of delivery.
tips.fires_vs_random: Snappy knee ascension yields 80.5% FF rate.
tips.scouting_note: Rotational torque generation creates lower-half tempo separation.
tips.what_to_spot: Front knee accelerates +16% faster to apex on FF vs smooth controlled rise on ST (3.8× visibility floor).

tips.title: Glove Height Stability & Bobble at Set · Fastball (FF) vs Slider (SL)
tips.cue: micro-bobble oscillation in hands reaching set
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical stability of hands settling into set position
tips.spot_the_difference: Gordon exhibits micro-bobble oscillation in glove height (hands pumping twice) before 4-Seam Fastballs, whereas on Sliders his hands lock instantly into frozen stillness upon reaching the chest.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Watch the glove from t=-1.00s to -0.70s. Noticeable hand pump/bobble = Fastball; instant frozen lock = Slider.
tips.direction: Rhythmic hand pump/bobble settling into set signals 4-Seam Fastball.
tips.lookFor: Two-pump micro-bobble settling at chest on FF vs instant frozen lock on SL (5.3× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove vertical displacement during final 0.3s of coming set.
tips.fires_vs_random: Glove bobble yields 87.0% Fastball rate.
tips.scouting_note: Rhythmic pump synchronizes four-seam finger pressure before leg drive.
tips.what_to_spot: Two-pump micro-bobble settling at chest on FF vs instant frozen lock on SL (5.3× visibility floor separation).

tips.title: Glove Flare Webbing Compression · Curveball (CU) vs Fastball (FF)

tips.what_to_spot: Tightly clenched/narrowed glove leather at lift apex on CU vs relaxed open mitt on FF (4.6× visibility floor).

tips.title: Leg Lift Ascension Tempo · Slider (SL) vs Changeup (CH)

tips.what_to_spot: Snappy fast knee drive on SL vs floating slow lift on CH (3.9× visibility floor).

tips.title: Glove Set Elevation · FC vs FF/SI
tips.cue: glove vertical anchor height at motionless set
tips.target_body_part: Glove Height / Belt vs Sternum Elevation
tips.anatomical_location: Vertical height of mitt relative to chest letters and belt
tips.spot_the_difference: When coming set at the belt, Zach Agnos anchors his glove +2.5 inches higher in front of his sternum on FC, compared to a lower waistline set on FF and SI.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync (0.00s = release): Look at glove vertical position at t=-0.85s. High set at chest = FC; low set at belt = FF/SI.
tips.direction: High chest glove set signals FC.
tips.lookFor: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on FC vs low belt set on FF/SI (4.8× visibility floor separation).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove height relative to jersey lettering during stationary set pause.
tips.fires_vs_random: High chest set yields 84.5% FC probability.
tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: Sub-pixel landmark tracking isolates pre-release hand placement discrepancy.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove anchored 2.5 inches higher at chest on FC vs low belt set on FF/SI (4.8× visibility floor separation).

tips.title: Glove Pocket Flare Width · SI vs FC
tips.cue: pocket flare width expansion during grip adjustment
tips.anatomical_location: Horizontal gap between thumb leather and pocket webbing
tips.spot_the_difference: Zach Agnos flares his glove pocket open wider (+0.038 torso widths) when adjusting his fingers for SI, compared to a compact narrow pocket profile on FC.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Compare glove width silhouette at t=-0.80s. Flared wide pocket = SI; compact narrow mitt = FC.
tips.direction: Expanded pocket flare at set signals SI.
tips.lookFor: Glove pocket expands wider at set on SI vs compact narrow profile on FC (4.2× visibility floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove horizontal profile silhouette during stationary pause at belt.
tips.fires_vs_random: Expanded flare yields 82.0% SI rate.
tips.scouting_note: Grip adjustment accommodation expands glove perimeter before delivery.
tips.what_to_spot: Glove pocket expands wider at set on SI vs compact narrow profile on FC (4.2× visibility floor).
